claims.sentence: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title> <jats:sec> <jats:title>Study Objectives</jats:title> <jats:p>The current study’s aim was to demonstrate the neurophysiological components of self-reported sleep quality through multi-wave assessment in a sample of healthy, young adults.</jats:p> </jats:sec> <jats:sec> <jats:title>Methods</jats:title> <jats:p>Young adults (n = 156; Mage = 20.3 years, SD = 3.2; 77.6 per cent female) completed a baseline online survey, followed by wearing an ambulatory electroencephalographic, and completing daily morning surveys for 10 consecutive days.</jats:p> </jats:sec> <jats:sec> <jats:title>Results</jats:title> <jats:p>Multi-level structural equation modeling suggests that, at the within-person level, fewer N1 minutes, and more N2, N3, and rapid eye movement minutes predicted higher daily reports of sleep quality.
